LEGAL

Privacy Policy

How MOOREZY intends to collect, use, protect and manage information when you use our website and services.

Draft last updated: August 8, 2026
On this pageScopeInformation collectedHow information is usedSharingRetention and securityYour choices and rightsCookiesChildrenChangesContact
This is a product-design draft and not legal advice. Update the company identity, address, jurisdictions, vendors and actual data practices before production use, then obtain professional legal review.

1. Scope

This policy applies to the MOOREZY marketing website and, once launched, the MOOREZY laundry-management platform, mobile experiences and related support services. It does not govern third-party websites linked from our services.

2. Information we may collect

Information you provide

  • Name, business name, email address and telephone number.
  • Account registration and profile information.
  • Messages, support requests and product feedback.
  • Billing and subscription information processed through approved payment providers.

Information collected automatically

  • Device, browser, IP address and approximate location.
  • Pages viewed, interactions, referral source and diagnostic events.
  • Authentication, security and audit information once account services are enabled.

Business data

When the operational platform is launched, customers may submit information about their stores, staff, consumers, orders, garments, payments and deliveries. The applicable service agreement should define whether MOOREZY acts as a controller or processor for that data.

3. How we may use information

  • Provide, maintain and improve the service.
  • Create and secure accounts and process subscriptions.
  • Respond to enquiries and provide customer support.
  • Send requested service notifications and, with appropriate permission, marketing communications.
  • Monitor performance, prevent fraud and protect users.
  • Meet legal, accounting and regulatory obligations.

4. Sharing and service providers

We may share information with vendors that provide hosting, analytics, communications, customer support and payment services; with professional advisers; during a lawful business transaction; or when required by law. We do not intend to sell personal information.

Before launch, list the actual service providers and international transfer safeguards used by the product.

5. Retention and security

Information should be retained only for as long as needed for the purposes described here, contractual commitments and legal obligations. We intend to use reasonable administrative, technical and physical safeguards, but no internet service can guarantee absolute security.

6. Your choices and rights

Depending on your location, you may have rights to access, correct, delete, restrict or export personal information, or object to certain processing. You may unsubscribe from marketing messages at any time. Identity verification may be required before completing a request.

7. Cookies and similar technologies

The website may use essential storage and, when enabled, analytics or preference technologies. A production implementation should provide appropriate cookie notice and consent controls based on the visitor’s jurisdiction.

8. Children’s privacy

MOOREZY is intended for businesses and is not directed to children. We do not knowingly intend to collect personal information from children through the service.

9. Changes to this policy

We may update this policy as the service and legal requirements evolve. Material changes should be communicated through the website, product or account contact information.

10. Contact

Privacy questions and requests can be sent to privacy@moorezy.com. Replace this draft address with a monitored company contact before launch.
